title: ForceRemoveRagdollFromWorld - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script

Forcibly removes the reference's ragdoll from the world

Syntax:
Function ForceRemoveRagdollFromWorld() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Removes the bandit's ragdoll from the world
Bandit.ForceRemoveRagdollFromWorld()
